name: Boom Khalzar
description: Piloted by Kurt Baratier, Boom Khalzar is a mechanical predator built to overwhelm. When battle damage triggers its SwitchStrike mechanism, heavy claws extend outward — expanding its attack range and crushing power to devastating effect.

ability.name: SwitchStrike: Extending Claws
ability.description: Once HP drops to 50% or below, the sub-layer releases its locks and centrifugal force pushes the heavy claws outward. One-time transformation: +25 ATK, +15% Crit Rate, +15 DEF. Khalzar becomes more dangerous the more damage it takes.

chain._note: SwitchStrike: +25 ATK when HP drops to 50%
SwitchStrike: +15 DEF when HP drops to 50%

special_move.name: Thunder Attack
special_move.description: Kurt Baratier drives Boom Khalzar forward in a relentless barrage — four consecutive crushing strikes designed to overwhelm the opponent before they can react. Leaves the enemy stunned and weakened.
flavour_texts: ⚡ **Thunder Attack** — Kurt drives Khalzar forward — FIRST STRIKE!
🌩️ **THUNDER ATTACK** — FINAL BLOW — OVERWHELMING FORCE — ENEMY STUNNED!
